svg.title: Raspipboy-3000
svg.desc: Featured build: exploded isometric view of a Pip-Boy 3000 built on a Raspberry Pi 3 with a 3.5 inch PiTFT. Parts: Screen body, Front middle, Front left, Front right, Control panel, Top front left, Right screen piece, Front lights panel, Scroll wheel, Wheel cover, Knob, Back cuff ×3, PiTFT Plus 3.5″, Raspberry Pi 3 B, LED board, 3 LEDs, Rotary encoder ×2, PowerBoost 1000C, LiPo 3.7 V, Slide switch, PAM8302 amp, Speaker. Wiring, per config.py: PITFT 3.5″: 2×20 HEADER, SPI0; SCROLL WHEEL: GPIO4 · GPIO17 · GND; KNOB: GPIO22 · GPIO27 · GND; LED ×3: GPIO18 · 23 · 24, 330Ω EACH; POWER: LIPO → POWERBOOST → 5V + GND; SWITCH: POWERBOOST EN → GND; AUDIO: JACK → PAM8302 → SPEAKER.
svg.text: A working Pip-Boy 3000 on a Raspberry Pi 3
with a 3.5-inch PiTFT. Exploded view drawn
from the project's own STL files.
